title: CI runs on merge_group
goal: Every queued combination runs the required checks before it reaches main
acceptance: ci.yml has a merge_group trigger and the plan job selects checks against main for it
Required checks validate and native-macos report on a merge_group run
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: ci.yml is a harness file: decide project-only or template first (AGENTS.md, "Changing a harness file")
Branch protection is changed by the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: one trigger or required-check change, then one observed run. Not a measurement.
